standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that the structural morphism of a gerbe onto its base induces a surjective morphism from the source to the square of the base
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 6666-6668)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies surjectivity of the arrow in the displayed diagram.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that in a 2-commutative triangle with a surjective arrow, quasi-compactness of one leg forces quasi-compactness of the other
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 6669-6671)
standard_prerequisites.use: Deduces quasi-compactness of the arrow into the square of the base from quasi-compactness of the composite.

standard_prerequisites.name: The descent statement for quasi-compactness along a flat cover of finite presentation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 6672-6676)
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes quasi-compactness of the diagonal of the base from the cartesian square.

core_obligations: Set up the diagram: display the commutative square relating the square of the source, the square of the base and the two stacks (proof lines 6658-6665)

Surjectivity and the triangle step: the morphism from the source into the square of the source is surjective, so quasi-compactness of the diagonal of the source implies quasi-compactness of the induced arrow into the square of the base (proof lines 6666-6671)

Descent: the square is cartesian and the vertical arrow is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, so quasi-compactness of the diagonal of the base follows by the corresponding descent statement (proof lines 6672-6676)
proof_roadmap: 画出 X → X ×_Y X → X × X 与 Y → Y × Y 的方块。
由 gerbe 的刻画，左上箭头满；复合准紧 ⇒ 右上箭头准紧（本章「满射三角」引理）。
方块是笛卡尔的、右垂直箭头满平坦局部有限表现 ⇒ 用准紧性的下降引理得 Δ_Y 准紧。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a gerbe over a base, quasi-compactness of the diagonal of the gerbe implies quasi-compactness of the diagonal of the base (author lemma at source lines 6650-6655, label lemma-gerbe-diagonal-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 6657-6677) displays the commutative diagram of squares, uses the surjectivity furnished by the gerbe characterization together with the triangle lemma of this chapter, and descends through the resulting cartesian square (proof lines 6658-6676). The diagram chase and the descent step are the content. H3.
